t: You're in Avondale Park, a small park in Kensington and Chelsea, tucked between Walmer and Sirdar Roads. It mixes formal gardens, sports facilities and open lawns, and it's believed to be home to Britain's first floral lawn. The name comes from Prince Albert Victor, Duke of Clarence and Avondale, the eldest child of the future Edward the Seventh and Queen Alexandra. He was second in line to the throne from birth, but he died before his father and before Queen Victoria, so he never became king.
